test_nested_modules: test that pybind11 nested modules have correct __name__ attributes and submodule functions work
test_reference_internal: test pybind11 internal references between classes A and B including constructor stats tracking
test_importing: test that Python types like OrderedDict can be imported through pybind11 modules
test_pydoc: test that pydoc can generate documentation for pybind11 test modules
test_duplicate_registration: test that registering two things with the same name in pybind11 returns an empty list
